messages:
Maya (oncall): paging in — production search errors spiked, 5xxs across eu-west, p95 search latency jumped to ~1.2s. customers reported timeouts.
Raj (sre): saw alert at 08:17 UTC, routing layer returning 502s from model-proxy. scaling didn't kick for a couple minutes.
Maya (oncall): mitigation: scaled proxy pool + rolled the staging model variant to blue. reduced errors by 60% within 4m.
Ben (infra): logs show a KV cache eviction storm — a hot key pattern for a new batch job. adding temporary cache TTL relax.
Lina (platform): is this the same pattern from last month? we had a mitigation doc but it didn't cover hot key cascading.
Zoe (pm): customer impact: 3 paid customers saw errors, no data loss but timeouts. we should notify CS with the impact note.
Maya (oncall): filed quick impact note in #incidents and pinged CS.
PostmortemBot: created incident record INC-2026-145 in the tracker and queued postmortem draft.
Raj (sre): for follow-ups we need: 1) hot-key detection in metrics 2) auto-scale tuning for proxy 3) postmortem w/ RCA + action owner.
Ben (infra): I can take the auto-scale tuning item, will add a PR to autoscaling-config repo.
Lina (platform): I'd like to own hot-key detection; propose a dashboard tile + alert when top key > X ops/s for 2m.
Maya (oncall): can we auto-schedule the postmortem? last time we missed some attendees because it was manual.
Zoe (pm): yes please — suggestion: PostmortemBot should propose 3 slots based on participants' calendars and rotation.
Maya (oncall): also want to improve postmortem template: include explicit customer-impact matrix (customers affected, duration, SLA consequences) and a mitigation timeline section.
PostmortemBot: noted. Existing template: "Summary, Timeline, Root Cause, Corrective Actions" — will propose new fields.
Raj (sre): can PostmortemBot auto-create GH issues for each action with labels: postmortem, priority, owner, due-date? that would help tracking.
Ben (infra): yes and include a link back to incident record. we should also have an action dashboard that shows owner, status, aging, and whether it's part of an open regression.
Lina (platform): small ask: auto-assign owners based on oncall rotation for first 48h so actions don't fall through cracks. then allow reassignment.
Zoe (pm): timeline: schedule postmortem within 48h, publish draft within 72h, actions assigned within 5 workdays. can we make those SLAs visible on dashboard?
Maya (oncall): sounds good. operationally we need two automations: 1) PostmortemBot calendar poll + invite 2) action -> GH issue creation + dashboard sync.
Ben (infra): sketching commands we could add to the bot: `/pm create INC-2026-145 --slots 3 --template postmortem-v2` and `/pm actions sync --incident INC-2026-145`.
Lina (platform): agree. also add a checkbox in template for "was customer notified?" and paste the exact CS message. saves back-and-forth.
Raj (sre): question: who owns implementing the bot work? can we scope as a week-long sprint for devex + one oncall engineer?
Zoe (pm): I'll prioritize this in next sprint planning. propose Epics: PMBOT-1 (calendar/slots), PMBOT-2 (template+GH sync), PMBOT-3 (dashboard). estimate 3 sprints full-team.
Maya (oncall): immediate short-term: Lina to add hot-key alert, Ben to PR autoscale tweak, Raj to add incident note to RCAs. Postmortem scheduled tentatively: 2026-06-02 15:00 UTC.
Lina (platform): starting hot-key alert now; will post PR link.
Ben (infra): autoscale PR up in 20m.
Raj (sre): adding initial RCA bullets to incident: KV eviction cascade -> model proxy 502s -> autoscale lag.
Maya (oncall): thanks all. follow-up: can PostmortemBot auto DM owners 48h before their action due date? that would be helpful. :thumbsup:
PostmortemBot: added feature request PMBOT-2.1: owner reminders.
Zoe (pm): next steps summarized: 1) short-term fixes (Lina/Ben/Raj) 2) automate postmortem scheduling + GH sync (DevEx + Platform) 3) build action dashboard (Product + EngSRE) 4) update template with customer-impact matrix.
Maya (oncall): tagging @here in eng-oncall — if anyone has objections to timeline, shout now.
Ben (infra): no objections, will follow up in PR.
Lina (platform): none. posting alert rule in #eng-platform for review.
Raj (sre): will add incident learnings to SRE rotation notes.
Zoe (pm): assigning myself to coordinate cross-team effort until devex takes over.
Maya (oncall): closing thread for now — will reopen after postmortem. Thanks everyone. :sparkles:
